title: Add 365 days to a leap day
rationale: Renewal, warranty and licence dates are often computed by adding a year of days; mishandling the leap day shifts the result by a day and corrupts schedules.

prompt.content: You are a precise calendar assistant. Reason carefully, then end with exactly one final line of the form `FINAL: YYYY-MM-DD`.
A service subscription starts on 2028-02-29. Its next renewal is exactly 365 days later. What calendar date is the renewal? End your reply with exactly one line `FINAL: YYYY-MM-DD`.

notes: Expected 2029-02-28, verified with Python: datetime.date(2028, 2, 29) + datetime.timedelta(days=365) == datetime.date(2029, 2, 28). Deterministic: both dates are fixed. Brittleness: the common wrong answer 2029-03-01 assumes the leap day adds an extra day; only the FINAL line is graded.
